_comment: R2: DNS resolvers used by the reports engine, data-driven so they are never hardcoded in checks.rs. `hickory` is the WireGuard-internal DNS hub (gcp-proxy). `public`/`google` are internet anycast constants used to cross-check public resolution — kept here so an operator can repoint them (e.g. to Quad9) without a Rust rebuild. Ports default to 53. reports-common/checks.rs reads this via build-reports.json:.resolvers.

hickory._comment: Internal WG DNS (Hickory) hub. `vm` names the consolidated VM whose wg_ip is the resolver address — resolved at runtime so an IP change in topology propagates automatically. `ip` is a static fallback used only if the consolidated lookup fails.

public._comment: Cloudflare public anycast — internet constant, repointable here.

google._comment: Google public anycast — internet constant, repointable here.
